title: Cute Fall Decorations!
text: Cute Fall Decorations!. These metal pumpkins are cute fall decorations! They are much nicer than I expected. There are some slight imperfections, but that's a part of the whole farmhouse decor thing. I'm not quite sure where I'm going to put them this fall, but right now they're on my mantel. I do like that they're not the typical fall colors. It's nice to have a change.
